reasoning_content:
Both endpoints are working. Next, let's run an end-to-end check with a real repository to prove that the badge evaluation works. I'll use the `check` command from the guide to test the badge evaluation. Actually, the check command also requires a git client, but it might work with an empty token against public repositories.

Let's try running the check command as described in the guide:
`go run main.go check --repository "https://gitlab.opencode.de/open-code/badgebackend/badge-api"`

This is the guide's own verification method.

action.command: cd /workspace && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin && SKIP_SAVE_TO_DATABASE=true timeout 300 ./badge-api check --repository "https://gitlab.opencode.de/open-code/badgebackend/badge-api" 2>&1 | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | tail -40; echo "EXIT: $?"
